```{r setup-options, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide",  # graphs only
  fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, out.width = "85%", fig.align = "center",
  dev = "png", dpi = 200   # raster images keep the PDF small with millions of points
)
```

## Load files + libraries

```{r}
#Debra's filepath
#input_file <- "~/Desktop/Statistics_Practicum/70_grand_20250701-20260630.csv"

#Ethan's filepath
input_file <- "../70_grand_20250701-20260630.csv"


#setup
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

get_mode <- function(x) { ux <- unique(x); ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))] }

```

```{r}
#read data and lowercase name
dat0 <- read.csv(input_file)
colnames(dat0) <- tolower(colnames(dat0))
if ("x" %in% names(dat0)) dat0$x <- NULL   # CSV row numbers, not data

```

```{r row-id}
#Aggregate duplicate records (same logic as the sample code)
#One row per calendar_id x trip_id x geo_node_name; passenger counts
#Summed, everything else taken from the first record.
#Grouping directly on the columns (instead of paste() to build a row_id)
#Gives the same result without the memory cost.

dat1 <- as.data.table(dat0)[, .(
  date               = date[1],
  trip_sequence      = trip_sequence[1],
  block_id           = block_id[1],
  block_abbr         = block_abbr[1],
  route_id           = route_id[1],
  route_abbr         = route_abbr[1],
  route_direction_id = route_direction_id[1],
  service_type_id    = service_type_id[1],
  property_tag       = property_tag[1],
  geo_node_id        = geo_node_id[1],
  latitude           = latitude[1] / 10^7,
  longitude          = longitude[1] / 10^7,
  public_stop_number = public_stop_number[1],
  boardings          = sum(boardings,  na.rm = TRUE),
  alightings         = sum(alightings, na.rm = TRUE),
  arrival_time       = actual_arrival_time[1],
  departure_time     = actual_departure_time[1],
  adherence          = adherence[1]
), by = .(calendar_id, trip_id, geo_node_name)] %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
#additional variables
dat_vars <- dat1 %>%
  mutate(
    date  = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    weekday = wday(date, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),     # Mon ... Sun
    day_type  = ifelse(wday(date, week_start = 1) >= 6, "Weekend", "Weekday"),
    time_stopped = departure_time - arrival_time,
    direction = factor(route_direction_id, levels = c(7, 9),labels = c("Northbound", "Southbound")),
    arrival_hour = (arrival_time / 3600) %% 24,
    hour_bin = floor(arrival_hour),
    period = cut(arrival_hour, breaks = c(0, 6, 9, 15, 18, 21, 24), right = FALSE, labels = c("Early AM (0-6)", "AM peak (6-9)", "Midday (9-15)","PM peak (15-18)", "Evening (18-21)","Late night (21-24)")))

```

```{r}
#remove missing and negative stop times
n_start    <- nrow(dat_vars)
n_missing  <- sum(is.na(dat_vars$time_stopped))
n_negative <- sum(dat_vars$time_stopped < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

dat2_raw <- dat_vars %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_stopped), time_stopped >= 0)

```

```{r}
#Stop order and stop IDs, per direction
#Order is taken from trips that served the full route (the most common
#number of stops per trip), so a missing stop on some trip can't shift
#the numbering for everyone else.

trip_stops <- dat2_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  group_by(direction, calendar_id, trip_id) %>%
  arrange(arrival_time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(trip_pos = row_number(), n_stops = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

full_n <- trip_stops %>%
  distinct(direction, calendar_id, trip_id, n_stops) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  summarise(full = get_mode(n_stops), .groups = "drop")
full_n   # typical number of stops on a full trip, by direction

stop_table <- trip_stops %>%
  inner_join(full_n, by = "direction") %>%
  filter(n_stops == full) %>%
  group_by(direction, geo_node_id) %>%
  summarise(geo_node_name = first(geo_node_name),
            stop_seq      = get_mode(trip_pos),
            pct_agree     = mean(trip_pos == stop_seq),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(direction, stop_seq) %>%
  mutate(stop_id = sprintf("%s-%02d",
                           ifelse(direction == "Northbound", "NB", "SB"),
                           stop_seq))
dat2_raw <- dat2_raw %>%
  left_join(select(stop_table, direction, geo_node_id, stop_seq, stop_id),
            by = c("direction", "geo_node_id"))

# Stops never served on a full trip (no position assigned)
dat2_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction), is.na(stop_seq)) %>%
  count(direction, geo_node_id, geo_node_name)


```

```{r}
# Remove stop times above the 99th percentile -> dat2 (final dataset)

dat2_raw <- dat2_raw %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  mutate(terminal = stop_seq %in% range(stop_seq, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

max_time_stopped <- quantile(dat2_raw$time_stopped, 0.99)
n_high <- sum(dat2_raw$time_stopped > max_time_stopped)

dat2 <- dat2_raw %>%
  filter(time_stopped <= max_time_stopped)

```

```{r}
#Cleaning summary

removal_summary <- data.frame(
  reason = c("Missing arrival or departure time",
             "Negative stop time (departure before arrival)",
             "Stop time above 99th percentile",
             "Total removed"),
  n = c(n_missing, n_negative, n_high, n_missing + n_negative + n_high)
)
removal_summary$percent <- round(100 * removal_summary$n / n_start, 2)
removal_summary

cat("Rows after aggregation:", n_start, "| Final rows:", nrow(dat2),
    "| Stop-time cutoff:", round(max_time_stopped), "seconds\n")
summary(dat2$time_stopped)

```

# Stop time vs. time of day

```{r theme}
#graph theme

theme_pub <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

dir_cols <- c("Northbound" = "#0072B2", "Southbound" = "#D55E00")
hour_axis <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 2), labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x))
```

```{r, fig.height = 5}
#jitter boxplot

p1d <- ggplot(dat2, aes(factor(hour_bin), time_stopped)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "#6baed6", colour = "#2171b5", linewidth = 0.25,
              scale = "width", adjust = 1.5) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(h) paste0(h, ":00")) +
  scale_y_sqrt(breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 20, 40, 60, 90, 120)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 125), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Stop Time by Hour of Day",
       x = "Hour of arrival", y = "Stop time (seconds with\nsquare-root scale)") +
  theme_pub +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
p1d
ggsave("fig1_stop_time_by_hour.png", p1d, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r plot-1b}
#southbound and northbound by hour, median by line

hourly <- dat2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  group_by(direction, hour_bin) %>%
  summarise(median = median(time_stopped), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n >= 20)   # drop hours with too few stops for a reliable median

p1b <- ggplot(hourly, aes(x = hour_bin, y = median, color = direction)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  hour_axis +
  expand_limits(y = c(0, 30)) + #axis covers at least 0 to 30
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5)) + #label every 5 seconds
  labs(title = "Median Stop Time Across Hour of Day by Direction",
       x = "Hour of arrival", y = "Stop time (seconds)") +
  theme_pub
p1b
ggsave("fig1b_median_line_by_hour.png", p1b, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Stop time by location / stop

```{r}
#Helper chunk
n_peaks <- 3     #slowest stops per direction to label and plot in Figs 1-3

# Mid-route scheduled timepoints from the published 70 Grand timetable
timepoint_patterns <- c("TRANSIT CENTER", "CHIPPEWA", "ARSENAL", "SAINT LOUIS", "ST\\.? LOUIS")

# Short stop names for labels: "GRAND @ CHIPPEWA NB" -> "Chippewa"
clean_label <- function(x) {
  x <- sub("^GRAND @\\s*", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- sub("\\s+(NB|SB)$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\s*@\\s*GRAND$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  tools::toTitleCase(tolower(x))
}

dir_abbr <- function(d) ifelse(d == "Northbound", "NB", "SB")

save_fig <- function(file, plot, width, height) {
  ggsave(file, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}

cap_theme <- theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
                   plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30"))

#Stop-level table (shared by all figures)
stops <- dat2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(stop_seq)) %>%
  group_by(direction, stop_seq, stop_id, geo_node_name) %>%
  summarise(n             = n(),
            median_time   = median(time_stopped),
            n_long        = sum(time_stopped > 60),
            n_long_no_pax = sum(time_stopped > 60 & boardings + alightings == 0),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  mutate(terminal = stop_seq %in% range(stop_seq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label           = clean_label(geo_node_name),
         timepoint       = grepl(paste(timepoint_patterns, collapse = "|"),
                                 geo_node_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
         pct_long_no_pax = ifelse(n_long > 0, 100 * n_long_no_pax / n_long, NA))

#Mid-route stops with enough data
stops_ok <- stops %>% filter(!terminal, n >= 20)

#Slowest stops per direction
peaks <- stops_ok %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  slice_max(median_time, n = n_peaks, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(direction, stop_seq) %>%
  mutate(panel = paste0(dir_abbr(direction), ": ", label, " (stop ", stop_seq, ")"))

```

```{r, fig.height = 8}
#median stop time along the route

y_step <- 10
y_max  <- ceiling(max(stops_ok$median_time) / y_step) * y_step + 2 * y_step  # room for labels

make_line <- function(dir_choice) {
  d <- stops_ok %>%
    filter(direction == dir_choice) %>%
    select(stop_seq, median_time) %>%
    tidyr::complete(stop_seq = tidyr::full_seq(stop_seq, 1))   # gaps break the line

  lab <- peaks %>% filter(direction == dir_choice)

  ggplot(d, aes(stop_seq, median_time)) +
    geom_line(colour = dir_cols[[dir_choice]], linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(colour = dir_cols[[dir_choice]], size = 1.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = label),
                    nudge_y = 8, direction = "x", size = 3.3, colour = "grey15",
                    segment.colour = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3,
                    min.segment.length = 0, seed = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(d$stop_seq), by = 5),
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), breaks = seq(0, y_max, by = y_step),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(title = dir_choice,
         x = "Stop number along route (first stop = 1)",
         y = "Median stop time (seconds)") +
    theme_pub +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}

fig1 <- (make_line("Northbound") + labs(x = NULL)) /
  make_line("Southbound") +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Median Stop Time Along Route",
    caption  = paste0("Labeled = ", n_peaks),
    theme = theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey30"),
                  plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30"))
  )

fig1
save_fig("fig_t2_1_stop_time_along_route.png", fig1, 10, 9)

```

```{r, fig.height = 5.5}
n_peaks <- 3 #slowest stops per direction

#Long stops with no passengers
# Stops to label (names as they appear after shortening)
label_stops <- c("Chippewa", "Cherokee", "Grand Transit Center", "Broadway", "Gravois")
drop_labels <- c("Gravois (NB)")   # specific direction labels to hide

hold_ok <- stops_ok %>% filter(n_long >= 20)

#Jitter
set.seed(42)
hold_ok <- hold_ok %>%
  mutate(x_j = median_time     + runif(n(), -1.2, 1.2),
         y_j = pct_long_no_pax + runif(n(), -1.5, 1.5),
         lab = ifelse(label %in% label_stops,
                      paste0(label, " (", dir_abbr(direction), ")"), ""),
         lab = ifelse(lab %in% drop_labels, "", lab))

#Label positions relative to each point
label_offsets <- tibble::tribble(
  ~lab,                          ~dx,  ~dy, ~hjust,
  "Broadway (SB)",                -2,   -5,    1,
  "Gravois (SB)",                1.5,    6,    0,
  "Chippewa (NB)",                -1,    7,  0.5,
  "Cherokee (NB)",                 0,   -6,  0.5,
  "Grand Transit Center (NB)",    -2,    5,    1,
  "Grand Transit Center (SB)",     0,   11,  0.5
)

hold_lab <- hold_ok %>%
  filter(lab != "") %>%
  left_join(label_offsets, by = "lab") %>%
  mutate(dx = coalesce(dx, 0), dy = coalesce(dy, 5), hjust = coalesce(hjust, 0.5),
         lx = x_j + dx, ly = y_j + dy)

#Plot
fig_t2_4 <- ggplot(hold_ok, aes(x_j, y_j)) +
  geom_segment(data = hold_lab,
               aes(xend = lx, yend = ly - sign(dy) * 1.5),
               colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = direction), size = 2.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = hold_lab, aes(lx, ly, label = lab, hjust = hjust),
            size = 3, colour = "grey15") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.08))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
  labs(title = "Long Stops With No Passengers By Stop",
       x = "Median stop time (seconds)",
       y = "Share of stops over 60s with\nno boardings or alightings") +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  cap_theme

fig_t2_4
save_fig("fig_t2_4_long_stops_no_passengers.png", fig_t2_4, 9, 7)
```

# Stop time vs. Boardings/Alightings

```{r}
ggplot(dat_rider, aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings + alightings)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped",
    y = "Boardings + Alightings",
    title = "Total Ridership Activity vs. Time Stopped"
  ) +
  theme_pub
```

```{r}
dat_rider$on_time <- with(dat_rider, ifelse(dat_rider$adherence > 60, 1,
                              ifelse(dat_rider$adherence < -300, -1, 0)))
```

```{r}
dat_rider$on_time_color <- factor(dat_rider$on_time,
                           levels = c(1, 0, -1),
                           labels = c("blue", "black", "red"))

ggplot(dat_rider, aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings, color = on_time_color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
```

```{r}
data <- dat_rider
data$on_time <- with(data, ifelse(adherence > 60, 1,
                                  ifelse(adherence < -300, -1, 0)))

cat("NA count in on_time:", sum(is.na(data$on_time)), "\n")
cat("NA count in adherence:", sum(is.na(data$adherence)), "\n")

data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(on_time))

data$on_time_label <- factor(data$on_time,
                             levels = c(1, 0, -1),
                             labels = c("Early (adherence > 60)",
                                        "On Time",
                                        "Late (adherence < -300)"))

p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = time_stopped + 1, fill = on_time_label)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "black", "red")) +
  facet_wrap(~on_time_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped (seconds, log scale)",
    y = "Count of Stops",
    title = "Distribution of Stop Time by On-Time Status"
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p1)
ggsave("time_stopped_histogram.png", plot = p1, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)

data$boardings_bin <- cut(data$boardings,
                          breaks = c(-1, 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, Inf),
                          labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3-5", "6-10", "11-20", "20+"))

p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = boardings_bin, y = time_stopped, fill = on_time_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "black", "red")) +
  labs(
    x = "Boardings (binned)",
    y = "Time Stopped (seconds, log scale)",
    fill = "On-Time Status",
    title = "Stop Time Variation Across Ridership Levels"
  ) +
  theme_pub

print(p2)
ggsave("time_stopped_by_boardings_boxplot.png", plot = p2, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
data %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.75) %>%
  filter(over_2500 == 0) %>%
  filter(impossible_ridership == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings,
             color = factor(PM_arrival))) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.025, width = 0, height = 0.15) +
  scale_x_sqrt(
    limits = c(0, 2500),
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 200, 300, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500)
  ) +
  scale_y_sqrt(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "blue", "1" = "orange"),
    labels = c("0" = "AM", "1" = "PM"),
    name = "Arrival"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped (square-root scale)",
    y = "Boardings (square-root scale)",
    title = "Boardings vs. Time Stopped"
  ) +
  theme_pub
```
